A Most Wanted – A Hajsza folytatásaként érkező műsorban teljesen megfordult a kocka: az eddigi nyomozók – Sebestyén Balázs, Frohner Fecó és Pápai Joci – lettek a Célpontok, akiknek öt napon át kell menekülniük a bosszúszomjas Vadászok elől. story.title: Scientists discover a surprising paradox in how our cells age
story.summary: Scientists have discovered that the body's cellular recycling system behaves very differently during aging than previously believed, with higher activity sometimes linked to worse physical health. c4393365be.title: Your gut bacteria could be changing how many calories you absorb

story.title: Your gut bacteria could be changing how many calories you absorb
story.summary: Scientists have developed a model showing that gut bacteria play a surprisingly important role in how many calories we absorb, meaning food labels may not tell the full story. In a controlled study, people eating a high-fiber diet absorbed about 116 fewer calories per day than those eating a typical Western diet, without feeling hungrier.
